MFJSORT E35 exit program reference in comments

purpose.domain_detail: Sort exit program for Micro Focus MFJSORT utility, implementing E35 post-sort output exit to filter/delete duplicate records based on a key field
purpose.summary: This is an E35 sort exit subprogram for Micro Focus MFJSORT. It is called for each record after sorting and deletes duplicate records based on a 5-character PID field (positions 2-6 of records starting with '1'). It tracks and reports counts of records read, written, and deleted.

notable_features: OCCURS DEPENDING ON (ODO) for variable-length SPA area
DISPLAY UPON CONSOLE for operator messages
STRING verb for building console messages
RETURN-CODE special register used for exit return codes
LINKAGE SECTION with mainframe-compatible MFJSORT exit parameter list
88-level condition names for record flags (FIRST-RECORD, SUBSEQUENT-RECORD, LAST-RECORD)
verdict.notes: The program_ids array shows 'PIC' as a program-id which is a mechanical parsing artifact from the comment block; the actual PROGRAM-ID is ZBNKE35. High comment ratio (37%) due to extensive documentation of the linkage area and return codes in the header.
